UserAccountDocument.title: User Account Document
UserAccountDocument.description: Stores isolated per-user activity stats, real-time cross-device cloud sync snapshot, look preferences, and playback handoff state.

activityStats.description: Aggregated listening statistics keyed by normalized artist and song identifiers.

sharedPlayback.description: Live active device playback state and remote transport commands.

accountData.description: Account-isolated onboarding state, profile, taste profile, playlists with tombstones, favorites with timestamps, EQ, AI settings, preferences, and playback history.

lookPreferences.description: Per-account UI look preferences (glassOpacity, compactTiles, springMotion).

updatedAt.description: Unix epoch millisecond timestamp of the latest sync.

UserDeviceDocument.title: User Device Document
UserDeviceDocument.description: Registered active device entry for cross-device handoff.

/users/{userId}.description: Private user profile, stats, full cross-device synced account snapshot, and shared playback state isolated strictly to the authenticated verified user.

/users/{userId}/devices/{deviceId}.description: Registered devices belonging to the authenticated user for cross-device playback handoff.
